orbit_direct_relabeling.law: labels exchanged among whole orbits of equal size inside the pair; the area of each draw is the cell-level area of the actual scores

p13d_rule_calibration.note: the scored configurations set the rule; they carry no verdict
p13d_rule_calibration.threshold_law: rank-sum law of the orbit counts

rng: ChaCha8, one stream per (use, run, cell or pair), seeded from the draw value through splitmix64

seeds.use: random unit triples of the property table
